SELECT dt.d_year, item.i_brand_id AS brand_id, item.i_brand AS brand, SUM(ss_sales_price) AS sum_agg 
FROM (
    SELECT d_date_sk, d_moy 
    FROM date_dim 
    WHERE d_moy = 11 AND d_date_sk IN (
        SELECT ss_sold_date_sk 
        FROM store_sales 
        WHERE ss_item_sk IN (
            SELECT i_item_sk 
            FROM item 
            WHERE i_manufact_id = 816
        )
    )
) AS dt 
JOIN store_sales ON dt.d_date_sk = store_sales.ss_sold_date_sk 
JOIN item ON store_sales.ss_item_sk = item.i_item_sk 
GROUP BY dt.d_year, item.i_brand, item.i_brand_id 
ORDER BY dt.d_year, sum_agg DESC, brand_id 
LIMIT 100
